title: Factor mining
desc: One model proposes hypotheses and writes expressions, ten code gates judge them, failures are rewritten with the numbers in hand, another model reviews; survivors wait in the observation area for you to approve.

auth.loginTitle: Sign in with the paper-trading admin account
auth.localHint: No sign-in method is enabled on this site, so you enter as the admin directly.
auth.noPassword: Password sign-in is not enabled on this site.
auth.notAdmin: This account is not the admin

overview.trialsHint: Each evaluated expression version counts once, rewritten ones included
overview.adminOnly: The mining process and candidate details are visible to the admin only.

data.title: Market data
data.none: No market data yet. Refresh first.
data.holdoutHint: Locked from this day, hidden from gates and models
data.costHint: Long-short leg, tiered by the symbol's monthly volume rank: 1-20 / 21-50 / rest
data.refreshHint: Lists symbols, pulls daily bars to rank the pool, then pulls 15m, funding, premium and metrics per symbol and assembles panels, and finally builds the reference grid. The first run is long; a rerun only fills what is missing.
data.thin: Thin coverage (kept in the pool, gaps are empty)
data.productHint: These symbols are loaded into memory for the time-series report only; it is shown to the reviewer and here, never gated.

pool.title: Universe
pool.hint: At each month start, the top N by 30-day average daily quote volume, using only data before that month. Delisted symbols included.
pool.statusHint: Per-symbol stats written at refresh. Click a header to sort.
pool.loadedHint: (6h grid moment, in-pool symbol) pairs used by the cross-sectional evaluation
pool.gridNotReady: not built yet, G6 fails until it is

campaign.title: Start a campaign
campaign.hint: After each round the model writes lessons and the next round starts on its own, until the round count, the survivor cap or the time limit is reached. One campaign at a time.
campaign.notePh: e.g. funding carry and liquidation imbalance only

lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.hint: Written after each round of the expanded campaign, newest first; proposals carry the latest 20 across all campaigns.

detail.pick: Pick a round on the left, or start a campaign.

cand.title: Candidates
cand.empty: No candidates in this round yet.
cand.directionAsked: an older candidate that never declared one; the generator was asked during re-evaluation, given only the hypothesis and the expression

observe.title: Observation
observe.hint: Candidates that cleared every gate, the review and the batch BH wait here with their holdout already computed. They are already in the redundancy set while here; approved ones also join the combination.
observe.reevalHint: Every candidate here is recomputed under today's gates (funding, known-effect references, direction) and screened against the others as one batch. Results are stored under each card; the original numbers and status stay as they were, and no trials are counted. About a minute each.
observe.peers: Cross-sectional |ρ| with the other candidates here

brief.neutralValue: after regressing out {{n}} known effects: primary IC {{ic}}, {{kept}} of the original, t {{t}} (a label, not a gate)
brief.unseen: Never seen by it (from its discovery round's cut {{from}})

library.title: Factor library
library.comboHint: Each library factor is ranked across symbols at each moment, z-scored and summed with weights from its training-window monthly cross-sectional IC, same walk-forward as single factors; holdout weights are fit on the whole search span.
library.comboNone: No data loaded, so the combination report can't be computed.
library.latest: Cross-sectional signal at the last grid moment ({{time}} UTC)
library.reevalHint: Every library factor is recomputed under today's gates: the G9 baseline is the library without it plus basis carry, G6 compares against the references, the other library factors and the observation list, G10 uses the direction it declared. Results are stored separately in the detail view; the approval numbers and status stay as they were. About a minute each.
library.recheckHint: IC on data after approval only.

reference.title: Reference set
reference.hint: 5 hand-written baselines plus the Alpha158 rewrite. A ruler, never approved; no redundancy check, no BH.
reference.windowsHint: None selected means every window; baselines and candle-shape factors always run.

models.title: Models
models.needBoth: Configure both the proposer and the reviewer first; the same model tends to agree with itself, so different ones are better.

eval.title: Evaluate an expression
eval.hint: Runs every gate on the search span and computes a separate holdout for you; not part of a round and not counted as a trial. Ctrl+Enter to submit.

trader.title: Trader account
trader.hint: Paper account quant-factor: every day it signals on the 15m bar closing at 00:00 UTC and rebalances the whole basket at 00:15 — half the capital on the combo of the selected factors, half on basis carry, both sides sized by inverse volatility, 4x cross market orders, no stops. The paper venue is optimistic: 0.04% fees, no slippage, low-volume coins fill at the mark price that updates once a minute; the backtest fills one bar later at 5 / 8 / 12 bps per side.
trader.noAccount: No rebalance yet: the account is created on the first one.
trader.schedule: Fetches data from 00:05 UTC and trades at 00:15; retried until 01:00, after that the day is skipped
trader.curveHint: One snapshot per hour; the dashed line is the initial capital.
trader.curveEmpty: Fewer than two snapshots so far.
trader.positionsHint: Leg split: target notional each leg gave this coin in the {{day}} rebalance (signed).
trader.runsHint: Click a row for that day: targets vs fills, and why anything failed.
trader.noFactors: No factor selected; the combo leg stays flat
trader.factorsHint: Only selected factors feed the combo leg, from the next rebalance on; being in the library does not mean being traded. Compare runs the trading scheme on the search span for the current selection and for it with this factor added or removed; holdout is shown only when the search span improves, so nobody picks by holdout. Selecting is your call.
trader.missing: The live tail cannot provide {{cols}}; cannot be selected

compareStage.inputs: preparing the skeleton and carry inputs

trader.betterYes: Search-span Sharpe is higher, so holdout is shown too (look once).
trader.betterNo: Search span did not improve; no holdout.
